review.method: static source/configuration review; CI and CodeQL; live Chromium/Playwright all-field attack matrix with test-only shield bypass; live keyboard/paste XSS smoke with real shield; live HTTP perimeter and exposed-path checks
review.limitations: The production web app at https://mofakira-anouar.pages.dev/mofakira-anouar/ was tested in an isolated Chromium/Playwright 1.56.1 profile. 70 representative attack cases (58 rule families and 12 semantic phrases) were injected into 15 editable text fields: 1,050 attempts with no increase in risky DOM and no XSS canary. The actual Anwar Shield was also tested with 13 suspicious samples by paste and typing (26/26 blocked) while benign Arabic writing was accepted. HTML/TXT/MD/CSV imports, personal adhkar and custom tasbih rendering, share URL scheme validation, password non-reflection, HTML export, invalid rescue rejection without data change, direct DOM editor bypass (zero active markup), and 41 live perimeter/header/file-boundary/PWA/CORS checks passed. The API gateway URL is empty and no gateway is connected to this production web build; therefore SQL/database, live SSRF, OS command injection, BOLA/IDOR and API authz attacks were not performed against an active backend. Detection-rule strings for those families only tested the client-side shield. This is not an independent certified penetration test and no physical mobile-device test was performed.

owner_reported_manual_xss_test.approaches: multiple manual XSS approaches; full payload list and per-case logs were not included in this review
owner_reported_manual_xss_test.result: No successful XSS execution was reported in the tested attempts. The input protection reportedly blocked suspicious terms and URLs before paste into fields and during typing.
owner_reported_manual_xss_test.scope_limit: This is a limited reported manual test, not a comprehensive penetration test or proof that all input, import, export, stored, reflected, and DOM XSS paths are safe.

live_editor_xss_smoke_test.environment: Chromium headless; Playwright 1.56.1; GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04
live_editor_xss_smoke_test.result: PASS: 13 representative suspicious samples were rejected by both paste and keyboard typing (26/26); no XSS canary fired and benign Arabic writing was accepted.
live_editor_xss_smoke_test.scope_limit: Covers the 13 recorded vectors and the live notebook editor in an isolated browser profile; it is not proof against every possible payload or a certified independent penetration test.

live_all_field_attack_matrix.environment: Chromium headless; Playwright 1.56.1; GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04
live_all_field_attack_matrix.bypass_scope: A temporary Chromium profile only; the test prevented Anwar Shield input listeners from registering so that downstream DOM sanitization was tested independently. No deployed script or visitor browser was changed.

imports.invalid_rescue_json: rejected; restore dialog remained closed and note/vault data unchanged

rendered_content.personal_adhkar: 8/8 samples rendered as text without active elements
rendered_content.custom_tasbih_dhikr: 4/4 samples rendered as text/options without active elements
rendered_content.share_url_protocol_validation: javascript: scheme rejected; HTTP and HTTPS only
rendered_content.password_nonreflection: passed; payload values were not reflected as markup
rendered_content.html_export: passed; title/body strings remained inert text

direct_dom_editor_bypass.interpretation: The current deployed editor's DOM sanitizer intercepted the direct DOM assignment; no active markup was observed in the live editor.

live_all_field_attack_matrix.scope_limit: 70 representative cases across 15 editable text fields (1050 field injections), not 1050 distinct attack types. SQLi, SSRF and command-injection samples tested client-side detection only; no database, OS command or actual SSRF request was sent. PDF/Office/image imports, valid rescue restore replacement, mobile browser, a connected live API and external-provider integrations are outside this browser matrix.

cors.classification: public static asset wildcard; no credentialed cross-origin access
